manychat.seoTitle: Jawab24 vs ManyChat: Best Auto-Reply for Arabic Businesses (2026)
manychat.seoDescription: Compare Jawab24 and ManyChat for Facebook and Instagram auto-replies. See which tool is better for Arabic-speaking businesses with Shopify and Salla integration.
manychat.subtitle: ManyChat is a popular chatbot builder that requires you to build conversation flows manually. Jawab24 is a different approach — an intelligent auto-reply system that understands context and generates natural responses without flow setup. Built Arabic-first with native Salla integration, dialect detection, and price verification.
manychat.advantage1: Arabic-first: Jawab24 understands 6 Arabic dialect families (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, MSA) and Franco-Arabic. ManyChat has no Arabic dialect support.
manychat.advantage2: Native Salla integration: Jawab24 syncs your Salla product catalog automatically. ManyChat does not support Salla at all.
manychat.advantage3: Price hallucination detection: Jawab24 verifies every price the AI mentions against your actual catalog. ManyChat's AI can generate incorrect prices.
manychat.advantage4: Confidence scoring: Jawab24 holds uncertain replies for human review. ManyChat sends all AI replies automatically without confidence checks.
manychat.faqQ1: Is Jawab24 better than ManyChat for Arabic businesses?
manychat.faqA1: Yes. Jawab24 is designed for Arabic-first businesses with 6 dialect families, full RTL interface, and native Salla integration — features ManyChat does not offer.
manychat.faqA2: No. ManyChat integrates with Shopify but does not support Salla. Jawab24 supports both Shopify and Salla natively.
manychat.faqQ3: Which is more affordable, Jawab24 or ManyChat?
manychat.faqA3: Jawab24 starts at $9/month with AI replies, template replies, and e-commerce integration included. ManyChat Pro starts at $15/month.
